name: MCB 5410
title: Exceptional Genetic Mechanisms
description: An exploration of the exceptional genetic mechanisms that are employed by selfish genetic elements that will stop at nothing–including the fitness of their host–to become immortal. Readings from primary literature will inform discussion about the mechanism of each drive system and what weak points the selfish genetic element exploits in order to gain a transmission advantage.
requirement_description: Not open for credit to students who have passed MCB 5895 when offered as Non-Mendelian Inheritance and Meiotic Drive.
